results.question: What's the most I can transfer in one day?
results.reply: The daily transfer limit for online and app payments is 25,000 pounds. The limit applies to the calendar day in UK time and resets at midnight.

results.question: Are you open on Sunday?
results.reply: Branches are closed on Sundays and bank holidays. The general phone line is also closed on Sundays. If you need assistance outside these hours, you can use the lost card line on 0800 555 0199, which is open 24 hours.

results.question: I've forgotten my app password. How do I reset it?
results.reply: You can reset your app password at the sign-in screen by selecting "Forgotten password". A one-time code is sent by SMS to the registered mobile number. If the registered mobile number is out of date it must be changed in a branch with photographic identification, as this cannot be done over the phone or in the app.

results.question: How much is the unarranged overdraft fee?
results.reply: The unarranged overdraft fee is 6 pounds per day, capped at 60 pounds per calendar month. It applies when the account goes below zero without an agreed limit or below an agreed limit.

results.question: Someone called claiming to be from Meridian and asked for my PIN. Is that real?
results.reply: Call 0800 555 0177 immediately to report the call; the line is open 24 hours. Meridian will never ask for a full password, a PIN or a one-time code by phone, email or text. If you have given any details, contact the fraud line straight away.

results.question: How long does a courier card replacement take if I order it before 3pm?
results.reply: A courier replacement normally arrives the next working day when ordered before 15:00.

results.question: How can I view my card PIN?
results.reply: A card PIN can be viewed in the Meridian app under Cards, then View PIN. The PIN is displayed for fifteen seconds and is never sent by email or text message. If you need further assistance, you can call the general phone line, open Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00.

results.question: How much does an international transfer cost and how long does it take?
results.reply: The fee for an international transfer is 15 pounds per transfer. It typically arrives in 2 to 4 working days. The receiving bank may add its own charge.

results.question: How much is the arranged overdraft fee?
results.reply: The arranged overdraft fee is 35p per day. It is charged for each calendar day the balance is below zero at the end of the day within your agreed limit.

results.question: Does the Meridian app support fingerprint sign-in?
results.reply: The Meridian app does support fingerprint sign-in on supported devices. This biometric option can be enabled in Settings under Security, with your password remaining as a fallback.

results.question: What time do branches close on a Saturday?
results.reply: Branches close at 12:30 on Saturdays.

results.question: How quickly do Faster Payments arrive at another UK bank?
results.reply: Faster Payments to other UK banks usually arrive within 2 hours. The scheme allows up to the end of the next working day, and a first payment to a new payee is more often delayed because of additional checks. Payments made after 17:00, at a weekend, or on a bank holiday are processed on the next working day.

results.question: Can Meridian ever ask me to move my money into a safe account?
results.reply: Call 0800 555 0177 immediately if anyone has asked you to move money to a "safe" account. Meridian Bank will never ask for a full password, a PIN or a one-time code by phone, email or text, and it will never ask a customer to move money to a safe account. Any such request is fraud.

results.question: How long does a standard replacement debit card take to arrive?
results.reply: A standard replacement debit card arrives in 3 to 5 working days. The replacement is provided free of charge.
